blocks.text: Minerals are inorganic substances needed to maintain physiochemical processes vital for living organisms. They produce no energy, but they have important functions in many activities. Minerals are classed as macro (major) elements and micro (trace) elements.

items: Macro-minerals include calcium, phosphorus, sodium, potassium, magnesium, chloride and sulfur.
Micro-elements include iron, copper, cobalt, iodine, zinc, manganese, molybdenum, fluoride, chromium and selenium.
The macro-minerals are required in amounts greater than 100 mg per day and the micro-minerals in amounts less than 100 mg per day.
